metric_notes.candidate_recovery: V3 full candidate pool before selection; model requires the independently labeled OF and model in the same candidate. Legacy pool unavailable.
metric_notes.geometry: Canonical plan geometry for independently labeled OF/model with one unambiguous geometry. These are not independent visual geometry labels.
metric_notes.confidence: Informational estimates, not calibrated probabilities. Diagnostic and held-out document/date groups are reported separately.
